notes: Marginalia (x.com/marginalia_md): notes in the margin of every trade, for Ethereum mainnet, paired with IMD. Marginalia is the launch ERC-20 with no constructor arguments. MarginaliaHook takes PoolManager, launch token and launch factory in that order; its five declared permissions encode flags 0x20cc. All enabled callbacks require PoolManager. beforeInitialize binds one pool and requires the supplied factory and LP fee 12500. The hook's constructor clones (EIP-1167) MarginaliaTreasury, MarginaliaRouter and MarginaliaJudge from the live launch-1240 implementations (0xe2086012f5F9CC7cAECDBC70dE392e263aAe8481, 0x365CcB3cfBC430600485234F56FD5ECb23fd70D1, 0xC93460730a79a22282f063A0c6BA5E340Ac372b4) and initialises each once; it reads the stateless MarginaliaPricer 0xEaff9B262341A0cB05579227e662BFE768A71cfb by staticcall; discover the clones through hook.treasury(), hook.router() and hook.judge(). The constructor reads no chain state. No contract has an owner, admin, upgrade or pause. Buying MARG through the router with a note in hookData posts a falsifiable call on any ERC-20: a flat 0.1 IMD stamp to the pools and a flat 0.5 IMD-equivalent MARG deposit locked for the horizon; sells of MARG pay 1% with a note and 3% without (exact-input only), kept as IMD claims; the hook's own deposit-return and pot-conversion swaps are exempt. A note's baseline comes from the router's hour-old venue checkpoint; it resolves on at least three observations spanning an hour (v3/v2 accumulator TWAP, the least favourable observation on v4 and the ETH/IMD hub leg) with a hold rule for BUY calls; right deposits return as MARG or fee-free as IMD; wrong, broken and retracted deposits forfeit to the pot, 10% to the settling keeper. A note may counter another author's note through parentId. Accruals split 70% weekly thesis prize (the judge buys one IdentityMD oracle ranking through the Intake 0x1397434cd35e8a9C8aC312A61D3A285EB31dea56, oracle.request@oracle-1, head 3; the hook pays 50/30/20) and 30% daily writer refund. The difficulty-weighted score on every call is reputation only: no pool pays for it.
